reviews.comment: He's a good guy with a pretty easy course and it's likely that the material will actually interest you because lectures are literally 100% class discussion. Tests are very study-able and most everything is writing intensive, but that is to be expected and he's not a particularly harsh grader about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Jafari is a great professor for Phil 111. He values everyone's opinion, as the class is based on participation. We get to discuss important moral issues and theories and apply them in different discussions. Very thought-provoking class and the professor explains the concepts and expectations very clearly!

Professor Jafari is a very fun teacher and always tries to challenge the class perspective to start conversation. The test are very clear and the review he makes for them cover everything in the test. Lectures are interesting and if you like to discuss issues and view different perspectives this is a great class.

Professor Jafari is a good professor but slightly disorganized and vague. He is extremely vague in both his rubric and responses to your questions, leaving you wondering what needs to be done. There is a tone to the reading, and it is difficult reading. He expects you to read almost 80 pages of Aristotle, Plato, etc. each day.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He does a great job at explaining the ideas discussed in complex readings, and he's great at starting class discussions. He is passionate about what he teaches, and it makes the class far more interesting. The one negative thing I can say is that he has a bit of an accent, so it is sometimes hard to understand him, but you'll get used to it.
He's an amazing professor, just be ready to participate and you can easily get an A. His lectures are super interesting and it's obvious he knows what he's talking about.

Super easy course if you just pay attention and do the work. There is only one exam which had like 5 open ended questions, 3 debate summaries, 1 group project and 1 final paper. All papers and projects have a detailed requirements and guidelines for you to follow.  Very accessible after hours and helpful.

His class is very engaging and he presents all of the topics in a clear and interesting way. The floor is always open for students to join in on the discussion and he makes people feel comfortable joining in. All grades are straightforward and clear. Great class!

Took Dr. Jafari in the summer. His lectures were very involved and he constantly pushed us to express our moral stances and opened the floor to arguments. Reading the material he posts lets you get more engaged in the class. About 3 papers and no exams. Overall enjoyable, engaging, and easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Jafari was a great professor and I learned so much from him. He made learning moral philosophy fun and engaging. The only problem was 90% of the class were gateway freshmen who didn't care. Attendance was mandatory every day but Dr. Jafari was very understanding regardless
